messages:
diane_cs: FYI — enterprise precall tomorrow 2pm PT. They want concrete answers on RBAC change process, audit log retention/forwarding to SIEM, KMS envelope flow, vuln triage SLAs, and IR handoff. Can we assemble a one-pager and quick artifacts?

samir_sec: I can own the one-pager. Quick checklist idea: RBAC change workflow + reviewers, audit log schema & retention, KMS envelope details, SIEM ingestion steps, vuln triage SLA, IR contact chain + evidence export.

maria_prod: Great. For artifacts we should have: (1) RBAC PR template link, (2) sample audit log event JSON, (3) KMS envelope diagram (ascii ok), (4) playbook snippet for a confirmed data-exfil event.

noah_infra: For SIEM forwarding — we support two options: push (HTTPS webhook) or pull (S3 bucket + collector). Default recommended is S3 with signed URLs + CloudTrail style envelope. Retention options we expose: 90d, 1yr, custom SLA for enterprise. We need to confirm customer's SIEM (Splunk/QRadar/Elastic).

samir_sec: RBAC change process (high level): dev teams submit rbac-change PR in infra repo -> security review tag @samir_sec -> automated policy check (terraform plan + least-privilege linter) -> 48h review SLA for routine changes -> 7d manual hold for org-wide role modifications -> emergency bypass with audit annotation. Example annotation: `rbac:approved-by:security/samir_sec; reason:hotfix; incident:INC-1234`

jenna_re: Do we have a canned response for the questionnaire Q: "How do you ensure changes to access control are auditable?" I can paste something but want it accurate.

samir_sec: Use this: "All RBAC changes are tracked as code; PR metadata, approvers, and any emergency bypass are recorded in our audit logs and linked to deployment artifacts. We retain immutable signed audit records for the period contracted (90/365/custom)."

maria_prod: I'll include the sample audit event. Draft below — pls sanity check:
```
{ "ts": "2026-03-10T17:22:31Z", "actor": "service-account:rbac-bot", "action": "role.assign", "target": "team-analytics:reader", "change_id": "chg-20260310-07", "approval": {"by": "samir_sec", "mode": "manual"}, "signed": true }
```

samir_sec: looks good. note: add field `evidence_refs` that points to PR url and signed blob id.

noah_infra: KMS envelope flow to clarify for them: Master KMS (customer-managed or Redwood-managed) -> per-tenant envelope key generated and wrapped under master -> ephemeral data keys used at inference/runtime -> logs and telemetry redact sensitive payloads before storage. Example ascii: `MASTER_KMS (wrap/unwrap) -> WRAPPED_ENVELOPE_KEY (s3) -> DATA_KEY -> encryption/decryption`

jenna_re: They asked if we support HSM/VPC HSM: answer = customer can bring an HSM via Private deployment; for Hosted we support customer-managed CMK on cloud KMS + envelope wrapping.

samir_sec: vuln triage + IR SLA to commit: initial triage within 4 hours (business hours), severity classification and mitigation plan within 24 hours, patch/patch-mitigation within 7 days for high severity unless compensated controls documented. IR handoff: security -> oncall -> customer success -> legal (if PII). We'll provide contact tree and runbook excerpts.

maria_prod: I'll assemble the one-pager and a slide deck with 1) process flow, 2) sample artifacts, 3) TL;DR answers for the questionnaire. Tagging @samir_sec and @noah_infra for final review by EOD.

diane_cs: Thanks — can we also add a short demo: show audit log event -> how we export to S3 -> how they ingest into Splunk (search example). Noah can you produce a small splunk query snippet?

noah_infra: sure. Splunk example: `index=redwood_audit sourcetype=rbac_logs action=role.assign | stats count by actor,target`

deploy-bot: deploy status: slides-redwood-sec-precall v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T22:11:02Z :white_check_mark:

samir_sec: Final note — redact policy: request-level payloads are redacted before logs. We store meta/headers, decision outcomes, but not chosen completion text for default contract. If customer wants full-text for their private deploy, we recommend Private with tenant-local log retention and KMS.

jenna_re: I'll draft the questionnaire answers and push to the shared doc. Expect PR for review at 17:30 PT.

diane_cs: Perfect. If anything urgent ping me. :thumbsup:
